name: Sudoku Duel
description: Sealed-tick competitive Sudoku. Both players solve the SAME puzzle in parallel. Each round, both players submit a SINGLE (row, column, value) fill SEALED — neither sees the other's pick until both have submitted. Correct value (matches the puzzle's solution) → cell fills on your board. Wrong value → strike. Already-filled / given cells reject (defensive fallback picks a valid empty cell instead). First player to fully complete the grid wins; hitting `max_strikes` first = loss; same-round double-solve broken by fewer strikes. Chat is DISABLED — players can't see each other's reasoning. Configurable: grid size (4×4 / 6×6 / 9×9), max strikes (default 6), and best-of-N match length.

phases.name: play
phases.description: Both players submit one cell fill per round. Round resolves when both have submitted.

entity_types.name: SudokuDuelPlayer
entity_types.description: A Sudoku Duel player. Sees their own grid (givens + cells they've correctly filled), their own strike count, and the list of (row, col) cells still empty. Picks ONE (row, col, value) per round.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Seat: 'white' (first-listed) or 'black' (second). Both players are equally active each round.

properties.name: strikes
properties.description: Wrong-fill count for this player. At max_strikes the player loses.

properties.name: cells_filled
properties.description: Number of empty cells this player has correctly filled this game.

properties.name: solved
properties.description: True once this player has correctly filled every empty cell in the grid.

properties.name: scan_thoroughness
properties.description: 0 = grabs the first plausible cell; 1 = scans the whole grid for the highest-confidence single-candidate cell each round.

properties.name: guess_aversion
properties.description: 0 = takes flyers on weakly-constrained cells; 1 = only fills cells where the value is fully forced.

actions.name: fill_cell
actions.description: Submit a single cell fill for the current round. REQUIRED parameters: `row` (1-indexed, 1 to grid size), `col` (1-indexed), `value` (1 to grid size). Sealed: your opponent does NOT see your pick until both players have submitted. After both submit, both reveals happen simultaneously. A cell that's already a given OR you've already filled is rejected by the engine — pick an EMPTY cell every round. A wrong value (doesn't match the puzzle's solution) counts as a strike and the cell stays empty.

agent_archetypes.name: Constraint Solver
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays canonical sudoku technique — naked singles, hidden singles, box-line elimination. Every fill is fully forced by the constraints; almost never strikes. Slower per move but accurate.

agent_archetypes.name: Quick Scanner
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Glances at the grid, fills the first cell it can prove. Wins on easy puzzles by sheer speed; strikes when the puzzle requires deeper inference.

agent_archetypes.name: Balanced Solver
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Hybrid — scans the obvious singles first, falls back to a 2-3 candidate elimination once they run out. Trades a few extra rounds of thinking for accuracy.

agent_archetypes.name: Bold Guesser
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Takes flyers on weakly-constrained cells when the easy ones are gone — racing to fill the grid before the opponent. High-variance: solves fast or burns through strikes.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.grid_size
runtime_parameters.label: Grid size
runtime_parameters.description: Sudoku grid edge length. 4 = 4×4 (2×2 boxes), 6 = 6×6 (2×3 boxes), 9 = 9×9 (classic).

runtime_parameters.name: domain.difficulty
runtime_parameters.label: Difficulty
runtime_parameters.description: Controls how many cells are removed from the solved grid. Easy = mostly naked singles; harder difficulties require constraint propagation. Expert approaches the unique-solution minimum.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.max_strikes
runtime_parameters.label: Max strikes per game
runtime_parameters.description: Wrong-fill count that ends the game in a loss. Lower = punishing; higher = leans toward a slow grind.

runtime_parameters.name: wins_needed
runtime_parameters.label: Games to Win Match
runtime_parameters.description: Games a player must win to take the match. 1 = best of 1, 2 = best of 3, 3 = best of 5. Tied best-of-N goes to sudden death.

runtime_parameters.name: premise
runtime_parameters.label: Scenario Premise
runtime_parameters.description: Optional framing — e.g. 'speed-deduction tournament' or 'inference championship'.

termination_conditions.name: match_won
termination_conditions.description: End the match when a player clinches the best-of-N.
